Title: Submit with Username blank shows required error

▶ Start URL:    https://www.saucedemo.com/login
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{
  "username": "",
  "password": "secret_sauce"
}

Preconditions:
  User is on the Login page; user is not authenticated

Steps to Execute:
  1. Ensure the Username field is empty (clear any existing text)

  3. Click the Login button

Expected Result:
  An inline validation error is shown: "Epic sadface: Username is required."; form does not submit; user remains on the Login page

Notes from prior verification:
  No steps changed. The inline validation message is a runtime result and was not part of the static DOM check.
